plugins.name: adf
plugins.description: Agentic Dev Flow core: the spec-driven change cycle and the contract its plugins extend

plugins.name: adf-gitlab
plugins.description: GitLab forge for the Agentic Dev Flow: pushes a change branch, opens its merge request and finalizes it through glab

plugins.name: adf-english-check
plugins.description: Stops an agent's git commit when the files in scope hold non-English text

plugins.name: adf-memory
plugins.description: Wiki memory for the Agentic Dev Flow: an indexed knowledge base, a log rotated monthly, and the ingest, query and lint workflows

plugins.name: adf-maintainer
plugins.description: Upstream for the Agentic Dev Flow maintainer: files a retrospective's flow findings and the open ADF debt as GitHub issues through gh

plugins.name: adf-npm-workspaces
plugins.description: Provisions an ADF worktree of an npm-workspaces monorepo: its own node_modules, linked to the main checkout's third-party packages and to its own workspace packages; blocks npm install in a linked worktree

plugins.name: adf-postgres
plugins.description: A disposable PostgreSQL database for each change and group worktree of the Agentic Dev Flow: creates it from the branch name, points the worktree's env file at it, and drops it at teardown

plugins.name: adf-prisma
plugins.description: Prisma for ADF worktrees: gives a worktree its own generated client when the change can alter it, migrates and seeds a worktree's own database, and checks the migration order at verify

plugins.name: adf-jira
plugins.description: Jira tracker for the Agentic Dev Flow: gathers issues at propose, starts them and hands them to the tester after the merge, plus guarded two-phase Jira skills for bulk changes, comments, epics, tasks, worklogs and the debt mirror
